title: Alleviating Stress Test Burdens to Help Investors Act

actions.text: Referred to the Committee on Financial Services, and in addition to the Committee on Agriculture, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

latest_action.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Commodity Exchanges, Energy, and Credit.

summaries.text:
Alleviating Stress Test Burdens to Help Investors Act
 This bill exempts certain financial companies not primarily regulated by either a federal banking agency or the Federal Housing Finance Agency from requirements to conduct stress tests.
 The Securities and Exchange Commission and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission may issue separate regulations requiring specified financial companies to conduct financial-condition analyses.
